column2: merge:oberst agreed, but Oberst is a noun in its own right (colonel); check the forms/examples before merging into the adjective
merge:Rüde agreed, but rüde is a real adjective (coarse, rude); check whether the forms are the adjective (keep) or the noun Rüde
merge:Klammer agreed, but klamm is a real adjective (clammy; also die Klamm, gorge); a cut-off of Klammer needs evidence
merge:Raute agreed, but rauen is an inflection of the adjective rau; merge:rau looks right unless the forms show Raute
merge:grillen agreed, but Grille is a real noun (cricket; grille); keep unless the forms are really the verb
merge:Wippe agreed, but wippen is a real verb; a lower-case verb is not a noun mis-filed
merge:Umkleide agreed, but umkleiden is a real verb (sich umkleiden); check the forms
merge:verbunden agreed, but der Verbund is a noun in its own right (Verkehrsverbund); keep unless the forms are participles
merge:Verweis agreed, but verweisen is a verb; check whether the forms are the verb (merge:verweisen) or the noun plural
merge:landen agreed, but "Lande" is the dative of Land (auf dem Lande); check whether the forms are Land or the verb
merge:drittens agreed, but Dritten is the inflected dritte / der Dritte (third party), not the adverb drittens
merge:Ersparte agreed, but erspart is the participle of ersparen; merge:ersparen looks right
merge:heilen agreed, but heil is an adjective (heile Welt); check whether the forms are the adjective or the verb
merge:Wehr agreed; could be the verb wehren; check the forms
merge:schreien agreed; could be the plural of Schrei; check the forms
merge:Wind agreed; die Winde (winch, bindweed) and winden are separate words; check the forms
merge:tanken agreed, but die Tanke (petrol station, colloquial) is a noun; check the forms
merge:Graben agreed; "Grabe" is the dative of Grab (zu Grabe) or the verb graben, not the noun Graben
merge:Buchse agreed; forms only "buchsen", could be the Swiss place Buchs or Buchs (boxwood); confirm
merge:Busen agreed; unclear form, confirm from the forms
merge:Gender agreed; looks like a fragment (e.g. of -gend words / Jugend), confirm Gender is right or drop/merge elsewhere
merge:Gruss agreed, while Grüße goes to Gruß; the Swiss spelling target should probably be Gruß for consistency (and Süsse -> süß)
merge:Gelb agreed, but the forms are probably the adjective gelb (compare Rote -> rot); check
merge:Griechisch agreed, but Französische goes to französisch; the adjective inflections should go to the same lemma type (check Spanische, Japanische too)
merge:Spanisch agreed; inconsistent with Französische -> französisch (see Griechische)
merge:Japanisch agreed; inconsistent with Französische -> französisch (see Griechische)
merge:Transparent agreed; could be the adjective transparent; check the forms
merge:für agreed; Fr is commonly Freitag / Frau / Franken (CHF), and "fren" suggests another verb; check whether für is really obvious, otherwise drop
merge:Fall agreed; lower-case "fall" may be English (fall), not the noun Fall; check the examples
merge:Detail agreed; lower-case "details" may be English; check the examples
merge:exklusiv agreed; "Exclusive" is the English spelling (product/brand text); English look-alike, probably drop
merge:responsive agreed; English web-design term, probably drop rather than merge
merge:Satellit agreed; may be English (Satellite) rather than a dropped letter; check
merge:Gras agreed; may be Günter Grass or English "grass"; check the examples
merge:Kicker agreed; mostly club names (Stuttgarter/Offenbacher Kickers)? check, a name would drop
merge:Merci agreed; French interjection / brand; check which, and whether it should drop
merge:erfurter agreed (lower-case target), while Berliner/Wiener/Frankfurter/Kölner/Leipziger/Nürnberger are agreed keep and Essener/Zuger agreed drop; decide demonyms consistently
merge:gelsenkirchener agreed; same demonym inconsistency as Erfurter
drop agreed; inconsistent with Berliner/Kölner/Nürnberger keep (demonyms); decide consistently
drop agreed; same demonym inconsistency as Essener
drop agreed, but units are release entries (README: units are not candidates); keep unless the rules say otherwise
drop agreed; unit (milliampere), as kWh
merge:Arm agreed; could be the nominalised adjective der/die Arme (poor person); check the forms
